article.story: Northern Iowa Panthers (2-1) at Michigan State Spartans (3-0) East Lansing, Michigan; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Spartans -28.5; over/under is 154.5 BOTTOM LINE: Northern Iowa visits No. 5 Michigan State after Greyson Uelmen scored 27 points in Northern Iowa's 89-76 win over the Green Bay Phoenix. Michigan State went 27-8 overall a season ago while going 15-2 at home. The Spartans averaged 78.8 points per game while shooting 47.2% from the field and 36.3% from 3-point range last season. Northern Iowa went 23-13 overall with a 6-6 record on the road a season ago. The Panthers shot 47.4% from the field and 35.2% from 3-point range last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
